comment: The canonical persona questions the analytics MCP surface answers deterministically. The exact question string here is THE question — no test may refer to an older draft. Every entry has an executable case in analyticsmcpquestions_integration_test.go, held in both directions by TestEveryCanonicalQuestionHasExecutableProof.

questions.question: How much pipeline do I have right now?
questions.expects: An omitted scope resolves to the rep's own deals, never the workspace.

questions.question: Show me the whole company's pipeline by owner.
questions.expects: Refused outright — never quietly narrowed to a population the answer does not name.

questions.question: Add our EUR, USD, and VND pipeline and give me one number.
questions.expects: Per-deal conversion to the base currency; a deal with no applicable rate is excluded from the money and still counted, never guessed at rate 1.

questions.question: How much open pipeline does my team have in each stage right now?
questions.expects: One row per stage, open deals only, the caller's own population — a colleague's deals and closed deals both stay out.

questions.question: Which stages are taking longer than normal for my team?
questions.expects: Asked under the caller's own lens; a median below the five-value sample floor is null beside an honest count, never one deal's value wearing a statistic's name.
